_comment: Short notes for display beside a reading, written here in all four languages rather than translated from opentorah's comments. Those are documentation for whoever maintains the data -- they argue about sources and rite keys -- and are shown verbatim, in whatever language they are, if at all. These are the sentences a person reading the calendar should see. Keyed by id; a reading refers to one where the UI needs it.

SOME_READ_SHORTER.fr: Certains lisent un passage plus court.

SOME_BEGIN_EARLIER.en: Some begin a few verses earlier.
SOME_BEGIN_EARLIER.ru: Некоторые начинают на несколько стихов раньше.
SOME_BEGIN_EARLIER.fr: Certains commencent quelques versets plus tôt.

NOT_ALL_READ.en: Not everyone reads a haftarah here.
NOT_ALL_READ.fr: Toutes les communautés ne lisent pas de haftara ici.

ASHKENAZ_ONLY.en: Read by Ashkenazim, and not by all of them.
ASHKENAZ_ONLY.fr: Lu par les achkénazes, et pas par tous.
